title: Krytan armor
wikitext:
[[Krytan armor]] is an art type used in Prophecies, Factions and PvP. It is only available for the [[core]] professions. The hero [[Olias]]' starter armor is also called Krytan.

==Prophecies acquisition==
In Prophecies Krytan armor art is used for the [[collector]] armor for each profession. Collector armor is available with an [[insignia slot]] at armor ratings lower than maximum, and the headgear is also available with an [[attribute bonus]].

The Krytan art is also used for Soldier's armor for warriors. This is available to be crafted with an insignia slot at [[Stingray Strand]] and [[Amnoon Oasis]].
